notes: Linked second result generation of the original Notes navigation run. Original source, failure metadata and failed chapters are inherited unchanged. Reviewed development recovery059af41 reconciled the exact completed AXPress failure, restored only the sole owned Notes card, closed it, restored audio and verified the same account at idle Home. The normal account-return segment then used five answered semantic actions, reached the signup/login landing, verified audio again, released the guard and deleted the temporary borrower credential; the issuer accepted return. Fixture ready describes the signed-in Home at lifecycle terminal73; the subsequent normal account return leaves the app logged out. No original failure is converted to a pass, no raw native reply/PID is fabricated, no complete original video is claimed, and no new full Notes or CI qualification was run.
